summary: Iteration 4: ACCESS KEYS system + bypass large-file fix (external URL) tested end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_keys.py (17 tests: key generate/list/delete/reset, HWID bind flow activated->ok->other_device, unknown/missing/deleted key, admin 401 boundary, public validate, bypass small-zip upload+download, bypass create/update via file_url) and /app/backend/tests/test_large_upload.py (55MB upload -> clear 400 with the ~50MB/URL message, no 500). Full suite run: 95/95 passed (existing auth/games/deps/purchases/settings/bypass regression + new). Frontend (Playwright, public URL, PT/EN/ES): admin login OK, nav-keys present, generate key (RZR-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX row appears, label cleared, 'Key gerada' toast), copy, HWID binding shown after public validate ('Travada no PC: PC-QA-UI'), reset-key clears HWID (only rendered when bound), del-key removes row; Bypass create with ONLY bypass-fileurl-new succeeds and redirects to /bypass/<id> showing the derived filename; bypass-fileurl-edit + bypass-fileurl-save updates the file (qa-updated.zip, 0 B) with success toast; bypass delete (window.confirm) works. i18n PT/EN/ES switch fine and Keys page title translates (Keys de Acesso / Access Keys / Claves de Acceso). All test-created keys and bypasses were deleted (Keys list and Bypass grid verified empty of TEST_ data).

minor.issue: Return {ok:true} (200) even for a non-existent key id - no 404. Silent no-op makes UI/API errors invisible.
Public and unthrottled; each call can bind a key to the caller's HWID. Key space is large so brute force is impractical, but adding basic rate limiting would be prudent.
Untyped `payload: dict = None` body (no Pydantic model); label is not length-validated. Same pattern as update_game/update_bypass.
If a cover file is uploaded and the main file upload then fails with the 400 (>50MB), the already-uploaded cover object is left orphaned in Storage (no rollback).

Still no brute-force lockout (playbook expects lockout after 5 fails); token in JSON body + localStorage (no httpOnly cookie); CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True. Unchanged from iteration 3.

ui_bugs.issue: Hardcoded English toast 'HWID reset' on reset (shown even in PT/ES) - i18n keys keys.reset exists; also error toasts reuse t('game.saveFail') instead of a keys-specific message.
nav.keys is literally 'Keys' in all three locales (pt/en/es), so the nav label does not visibly translate (page title does). Intentional? If not, use 'Keys de Acesso'/'Access Keys'/'Claves'.

Upload failures are swallowed into a generic toast (t('game.saveFail')/t('deps.uploadFail')). The backend's specific 400 message about the ~50MB Storage cap + 'use an external URL' never reaches the admin, defeating the point of the fix. Surface err.response.data.detail.
Create form's file input is a raw unstyled <input type=file> using the text-input class (bypass-file-new) - visually inconsistent with the styled upload button used on the manage page.
Delete key has no confirmation (single click revokes permanently), while bypass/game delete uses window.confirm. Inconsistent and destructive.

issues: No visible layout/contrast problems at 1920x1080; key rows, badges (cyan/emerald), buttons and empty state all render correctly.

action_items: Surface the backend 400 detail (50MB / use external URL) in BypassManage toasts instead of a generic error message.
Translate the 'HWID reset' toast in Keys.js and decide whether nav.keys should differ per locale.
Return 404 from DELETE /api/keys/{id} and POST /api/keys/{id}/reset when the key does not exist.
Optional: add a confirm step to key deletion; model /api/keys body with Pydantic; roll back the uploaded cover when the bypass file upload fails.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 587 lines with keys+bypasses+games+purchases in one module - split into routers before it crosses the 700-line threshold.
create_key's uniqueness loop leaves `key` bound to the last generated value if all 5 attempts collide; there is no unique-constraint fallback/error path.
validate_key mutates state (binds hwid) on a public, unauthenticated POST - document/limit this; also `status` is never set to 'used' so 'single-use' is enforced solely by the hwid column.

Historical 500s in backend.err.log for /api/keys and /api/keys/validate were Supabase PGRST205 'Could not find the table public.access_keys in the schema cache' (before ~07:36 today); resolved after the schema cache refreshed. No 500s during this iteration's runs.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_concurrency.py (replaced /purchases/count with /bypasses - the endpoint is admin-only by design and made the unauthenticated concurrency test fail with 401s)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (login, keys generate/copy/bind/reset/delete, bypass create-via-URL, bypass URL update, bypass delete, i18n PT/EN/ES)

seed_data_creation: Transient TEST_ keys and bypasses created via API and UI; all deleted (Keys list empty, no TEST_ bypass cards remain). One 55MB upload attempt was rejected by Storage so nothing was persisted.

rca_of_the_issue: The >50MB bypass upload fix works as designed: Supabase Storage returns 400 and the backend converts it into HTTP 400 with a clear PT message (no 500), and the external file_url path stores {filename,url,size:0} on both create and update. Remaining gap is purely presentational - the frontend replaces that detail with a generic error toast, so the admin is not told to use a URL.
